BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing that the department of revenue is the secretary of state's agent for specified legal entity renewals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing that the department of revenue is the secretary of state's agent for specified legal entity renewals; and amending RCW 43.07.200.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 43.07.200 and 2011 c 298 s 24 are each amended to read as follows:Department of revenue as secretary of state's agent for legal entity renewals.
BillSection.P: The secretary of state and the director of revenue may must enter into agreements designating the department of revenue as the secretary of state's agent for issuing all or administering under chapter 19.02 RCW a portion of the legal entity renewals annual report filings within the jurisdiction of the secretary of state, to include both domestic and foreign:

AnnNote.NoteP: Purpose—Intent—Agency transfer—Contracting—Effective date—2011 c 289: See notes following RCW 19.02.020.
